BranchID.reason: Acts as a foreign key or organizational identifier linking employees to specific branch locations.

EmployeeID.reason: Unique primary key identifier assigned to each employee.

FirstName.reason: Directly identifies an individual employee by name.

Hiredate.reason: Represents the date the employee was hired, stored as a string format requiring parsing.

LastName.reason: Directly identifies an individual employee by surname.

ManagerID.reason: Acts as a self-referencing foreign key pointing to the EmployeeID of the employee's manager.

Position.reason: Represents the job role or title of the employee with a limited set of recurring values (subject to data quality standardization due to typos like 'Manger' and 'Manage').
